applicability: Review source-content reads (/api/review/intent/source-content) of one leaf's review comparison, for a path its requested measured tree pair does not list as changed.
conditions: The requested string validates as a path seed and the validated value equals the requested string exactly.
exclusions: Spellings the seed rule would normalize (surrounding whitespace, tab, newline), which are never matched to the path they normalize to.
statement: An unchanged path is admitted only for the exact requested spelling a recorded anchor carries; a spelling the path-seed rule would normalize (surrounding whitespace, tab, newline) is refused and never matched to the path it normalizes to.
